scope: Minimal native Cubical Cauchy-modulus boundary: the quotient by equality of the limit admits a limit function (C-129); two representations of the constant-true sequence with given moduli 0 and 1 are identified while their moduli differ (C-130); no function out of the quotient uniformly recovers the given modulus (C-131); refining the identity relation to include the modulus yields a modulus function on the refined quotient (C-132) and the two representations are not related (C-133). Boundary result with positive controls; not a HoTT paradox.
theory_variant: Cubical Agda with native Path and higher inductive types
